readings.Aries: You thrive in motion. Today the most important motion is internal. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Taurus: Your senses are your instruments. When did you last use them on something purely for enjoyment? Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Gemini: The commitment you're avoiding isn't wrong to want — you're avoiding the vulnerability of wanting it. The first instinct was right.
readings.Cancer: Your intuition is more accurate than your analysis right now. Trust the feeling. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Leo: The applause you remember most is the one that surprised you. Aim for that. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Virgo: The thing you're not saying is specific enough to be said. Say it that specifically. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Libra: You are diplomatic to a fault. The fault is visible to others even when you don't intend it. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Scorpio: The transformation you're in the middle of is not comfortable. It's not supposed to be. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Sagittarius: The adventure you need does not require travel. Change the frame of what's in front of you. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Capricorn: There is warmth in you that your efficiency sometimes buries. Let it surface. Let this one be easy.
readings.Aquarius: Something you're doing for the collective has drifted away from the reason you started. Reconnect with the reason. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Pisces: Your inner life is extraordinarily rich. The outer life sometimes doesn't know what to do with it. What worked before will not work the same way this time.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
